title: Legacy Pigman
description: Return Zombified Piglins to their old selves
body:
A simple resource pack that replaces Zombified Piglins with Zombie Pigmen

This pack supports other resource packs by using a seperate texture for the Zombie Pigman, to add support just add `minecraft:textures/entity/zombie_pigman.png` to your pack

YOU NEED [ENTITY MODEL FEATURES](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) FOR THIS TO WORK !!!
